hints.title: Functional Directed Graph
hints.text: Every node has at most one outgoing edge, so cycles are completely disjoint.

hints.title: Timestamped Traversal
hints.text: Keep track of the step count at which each node was visited in the current exploration path.

hints.title: Cycle Length Deduction
hints.text: If a traversal re-visits a node encountered in the current path, the cycle length is the current step minus the node's first seen step.

hints.title: Path Step Traversal Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in graph
complexity.notes: Each node is visited at most once across all traversals.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-traversing components without global visited state incurs quadratic runtime.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Global visited boolean array and step lookup dictionary per path.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Leverages the out-degree at most 1 property to detect cycles in linear time.
